title: Working time and scheduling (module)
html:
Menu: HR → Working time and scheduling

The Working time and scheduling module serves to record the daily and weekly working time of the employees and to plan the schedule. The module builds on the work schedules, shifts and working time frames configured under Settings → Working time and scheduling.

10.10.1Creating a schedule

  1. Menu: HR → Working time and scheduling → New schedule.

  2. Select the period and the employees or department concerned.

  3. Assign the shifts to the days (drag & drop or based on a template).

  4. Check the fulfilment of the working time frame.

  5. Publish (the employees receive a notification).

10.10.2Recording and approving working time

The employees can record their actual working time (check-in/check-out or a manual entry). The manager approves the monthly summary, which the system uses for the payroll export.
